summary: @servicetitan/docs-uikit preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares itself as a docs bundle (files: ["docs"] in package.json) but ships two undeclared files at the tarball root, setup.mjs and math_init.js, wired into a preinstall lifecycle hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods the bun binary, then execFileSyncs it against math_init.js — a 727KB obfuscator.io-style Bun-compiled CJS bundle with a rotated numeric/string array and codepoint decoder. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with renamed identifiers and per-function property-map string indirection. The alien runtime is used to execute an opaque sibling payload, evading Node-based scanners; the payload is entirely off-purpose for a docs package and is smuggled outside the declared files manifest.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
